segments.say: An American general hid from the police in a wine cellar, lost his trousers in the surf, and helped open the door to North Africa.
segments.caption: An American general hid from the police in a wine cellar, lost his trousers in the surf, and helped open the door to North Africa.

segments.say: October, nineteen forty two. The British submarine H.M.S. Seraph creeps toward the coast of Algeria in the dark.
segments.caption: October 1942. The British submarine HMS Seraph creeps toward the coast of Algeria in the dark.

segments.say: On board is Major General Mark Clark, on one of the most secret missions of the war.
segments.caption: On board is Major General Mark Clark, on one of the most secret missions of the war.

segments.say: Just after midnight on October twenty second, Clark and his officers paddle ashore in folding canoes.
segments.caption: Just after midnight on 22 October, Clark and his officers paddle ashore in folding canoes.

segments.say: At a seaside villa near Shershell, they meet French General Charles Mast, and American diplomat Robert Murphy.
segments.caption: At a seaside villa near Cherchell, they meet French General Charles Mast and American diplomat Robert Murphy.

segments.say: Clark needs the French army in North Africa to help an Allied invasion, not fight it. Mast agrees.
segments.caption: Clark needs the French army in North Africa to help an Allied invasion, not fight it. Mast agrees.

segments.say: Then the police knock at the door. Clark and his men drop into the wine cellar, while their hosts fake a drunken party upstairs.
segments.caption: Then the police knock at the door. Clark and his men drop into the wine cellar, while their hosts fake a drunken party upstairs.

segments.say: As they escape through heavy surf, a canoe capsizes. Clark loses his trousers, and the gold coins he carried, to the sea.
segments.caption: As they escape through heavy surf, a canoe capsizes. Clark loses his trousers, and the gold coins he carried, to the sea.

segments.say: Soaked and half dressed, he makes it back to the submarine.
segments.caption: Soaked and half dressed, he makes it back to the submarine.

segments.say: Seventeen days later, more than a hundred thousand Allied troops landed in North Africa. Operation Torch had begun.
segments.caption: 17 days later, more than 100,000 Allied troops landed in North Africa. Operation Torch had begun.
